calls.title: Mojo and GrowthBook
calls.summary: The meeting addressed several product feature enhancements designed to improve experimentation for Enterprise plan users. Key highlights include the introduction of Post Stratification, which can reduce experiment times by 30-40% and deliver results within two weeks, increasing decision confidence. The beta launch of a new Visual Editor allows users to create experiments easily via a Chrome extension, with a general availability release planned soon. Control features like Holdouts and Monitored Ramp Ups provide options for safer experimentation. Additionally, AI-powered tools via Claude integration automate various processes, enhancing experiment management efficiency. Concerns regarding Power Calculator accuracy and technical limitations with Sticky Bucketing were also discussed, with commitments for follow-up support to resolve these issues.
calls.keywords: post stratification, power calculator, sticky bucketing, Claude AI skills, holdouts, monitored ramp-ups
